notes.title: 14mv2 Major Content Update & 14mv1 Feature Update
notes.content:
Hi all,

Ten months after the release of 14 Minesweeper Variants 2, we're excited to bring fresh updates to both 14 Minesweeper Variants 1 and 2!

For [b]14 Minesweeper Variants 2[/b]:
[olist]
[*] 472 new level sets, featuring new combinations of rules from 14mv1+2, including [1+2#], [1+2&] and more.
[*] In Ultimate Mode, you can now enable the "+A" mod (auto-reveal) together with the "!" mod (hide deductible count).
[*] Updated Japanese translations.
[*] Minor visual improvements and bug fixes.
[/olist]

For [b]14 Minesweeper Variants 1[/b]:
[olist]
[*] We have backported the free hints feature from 14mv2! You can enable it in the options menu.
[*] In Ultimate Mode, you can now enable the "+A" mod (auto-reveal) together with the "!" mod (hide deductible count).
[*] Updated Japanese translations.
[*] Minor visual improvements and bug fixes.
[/olist]

We hope you enjoy the new puzzles and features—happy sweeping!

Alith

notes.title: Content Update #1 & Mac Version Release
notes.content:
Hi all,

We are happy to announce that the first content update of 14 Minesweeper Variants 2 (14mv2) is coming. This time, we bring the combination of the rules in 14mv2 and its prequel (14mv1), as a free update to 14mv2!

[list]
[*] Mac version released, with cross-platform Steam Cloud support
[*] 98 new puzzle sets by combining the rules from 14 Minesweeper Variants 1 and 2
[*] The new puzzle sets can be unlocked by [spoiler] perfecting 10 [+]8x8 puzzles[/spoiler] in 14 Minesweeper Variants 2
[*] You can access the new puzzle sets for free even if you do not own 14 Minesweeper Variants 1
[*] 4 [spoiler]+4[/spoiler] new galleries and 9 new achievements
[*] Minor improvements and bug fixes
[/list]

We expect to explore more in the combined rule set with our community and present it to you in future content updates. Stay tuned!

Thanks,
Alith and Artless
